title: Background Agents in Slack Integration
description: Cursor launched a Slack integration that allows users to launch Background Agents directly from Slack conversations by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read the thread context, understand discussions, and create PRs in GitHub without leaving Slack.

title: Better Debugging with GitHub Copilot on the Web
description: GitHub improved the web-based Copilot debugging experience, making it easier to debug code directly in the browser interface with enhanced tooling.

title: View and Manage Agent Sessions from Issues and Projects
description: GitHub added the ability to view and manage Copilot agent sessions directly from issues and project boards, improving workflow integration and visibility.

title: C++ Code Intelligence for GitHub Copilot CLI in Public Preview
description: GitHub added C++ code intelligence capabilities to Copilot CLI, now available in public preview for C++ developers with enhanced language support.

title: Support for Latest LLMs Including Claude 3.7 Sonnet
description: Aider continues to support the latest LLMs including Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek R1 & Chat V3, OpenAI o1, o3-mini & GPT-4o, with compatibility for over 100 programming languages.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI Now Supports Copilot Auto Model Selection
description: Copilot CLI gained support for automatic model selection, helping users choose the best model for their tasks without manual configuration.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Now Generally Available
description: GitHub announced that Claude Opus 4.7 is now generally available in Copilot, continuing the integration of Anthropic's most capable model into the Copilot ecosystem.

title: BugBot Automatic Code Review
description: Cursor 1.0 introduced BugBot, an automatic code review feature that reviews PRs and catches potential bugs. Issues found are commented directly on PRs with 'Fix in Cursor' links.

title: MCP One-Click Install and OAuth Support
description: Cursor added one-click MCP server installation and OAuth support, making it easier to connect to third-party tools and services with streamlined authentication.

title: Background Agent for All Users
description: Cursor expanded Background Agent access from early preview to all users, allowing parallel task execution in remote environments. Users can access it via the cloud icon or Cmd/Ctrl+E.

title: Agent Support for Jupyter Notebooks
description: Cursor's Agent can now implement changes directly in Jupyter Notebooks, creating and editing multiple cells. This feature is initially supported with Sonnet models for data science workflows.

title: Memories Feature Beta
description: Cursor introduced Memories beta, allowing the AI to remember facts from conversations and reference them in future sessions. Memories are stored per project at an individual level.

title: Richer Chat Responses with Visualizations
description: Cursor can now render visualizations directly in conversations, including Mermaid diagrams and Markdown tables for better understanding of complex concepts and data.

title: New Settings and Dashboard with Usage Analytics
description: Cursor released a new dashboard interface showing individual and team usage analytics, display name management, and detailed statistics broken down by tool or model.

title: Model Selection for Claude and Codex Agents on github.com
description: GitHub improved model selection capabilities for Claude and Codex agents directly on the github.com interface, giving users more control over which AI models they use.

title: Copilot Data Residency in US + EU and FedRAMP Compliance Now Available
description: GitHub announced new data residency options for Copilot with US and EU storage locations, along with FedRAMP compliance for government customers.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration
description: Windsurf continues to feature MCP integration, allowing users to enhance AI workflows by connecting to custom tools and services for extended capabilities.

title: Continuous AI Code Quality Checks
description: Continue.dev continues to offer source-controlled AI checks on every pull request, allowing teams to define standards as checks enforced by AI with human decision-making.

title: Terminal-Based Agentic Coding Tool
description: Claude Code continues to offer its terminal-based agentic coding tool that helps developers build features from descriptions, debug issues, navigate codebases, and automate tedious tasks directly from the terminal.

title: Nubank Case Study: 8-12x Engineering Efficiency Gains
description: Devin published a case study showing how Nubank achieved 8-12x efficiency gains and over 20x cost savings on a major ETL migration project using Devin's AI agents.
